uh9aaSIkMiI.title: How Salt Melts Ice: Chemistry Explained
uh9aaSIkMiI.hook_line: You've seen trucks dump salt on frozen roads, but how does it actually melt the ice?

biggest_drops.line: First, water molecules on the ice surface are constantly shifting back and forth between solid and liquid.
Step two: when you add salt, the sodium and chloride ions dissolve into that thin liquid layer.
